family: deterministic human-mosquito SEIR-SEI, time-varying vector abundance (windowed phenomenological seasonality) + adult mortality scaling
state_note: x(1:7) is the dynamical model of theory/model_spec.md Sec.2. x(8)='Cum' accumulates true local incidence eta(t)=sigma_h*E_h. Cum feeds back into NO equation, so the 7x7 Jacobian and every stability statement of T08/T09 are unchanged; it is an observational accumulator that makes weekly aggregation quadrature-exact instead of trapezoidal.

equations.mu_eff: mu_s*mu_v_variant(T)   [variant = 'raw' (continuous rate) or 'day' (1-exp daily fraction, source-faithful for dt=1 stepping); see mu_variant_note]
equations.s_normalisation: s = s_hat/mean(s_hat) over the 329-day window; then s <- max(s, s_floor)
equations.R0_t: sqrt(m*a^2*b*c*sigma_v/(gamma_h*mu*(mu+sigma_v))),  m = m0*s(t),  mu = mu_s*mu_v_raw(T(t)),  sqrt convention declared
equations.T0_t: rho/log(R0_t) for R0_t>1 (Hartfield & Alizon 2013 with rho = detection fraction p; definition source verified 2026-10-05)
equations.observation: Y_w | dC_{w-d} ~ Binomial(dC_{w-d}, rho); Poisson(rho*dC_{w-d}) for large counts / low rho

thermal_traits.source: Mordecai et al. 2017, PLoS NTD 11(4):e0005568, Table A (Ae. albopictus)
thermal_traits.mu_v_raw: 1/lf capped at mu_v_cap_per_day; mu_v_raw = mu_v_cap_per_day where lf<=0
thermal_traits.quadratic: q(T) = c*(T-T0)*(T-Tm) on (T0,Tm), else 0 (c<0 => positive inside)

initial_conditions.meaning: entire population susceptible, no historical immunity; vector pool initialised at the t0 abundance, all susceptible; every local infection must be seeded by the importation forcing Lambda(t)

T_daily.interpolation: zoh (zero-order hold on the daily grid) by default; 'linear' selectable and recorded

Lambda_daily.note: daily values are a uniform within-week reallocation of weekly counts (NOT real daily data); used only as a forcing of I_h

reference_metrics.provenance: report/REFIT_REPORT.md, output/results/refit_v2.json (legacy Python refit, gen3 main report point)

mu_variant_note: Source code fact (read-only audit 2026-10-05): source dengue_rhs.m calls thermal_traits_day(T), i.e. mu_day = 1-exp(-mu_raw) when mu_raw>0.5, AND the gen3 fit then multiplies by mu_s BEFORE stepping. Hence mu_eff = mu_s*mu_day can reach 12.2/day and the '|1-mu*dt|<1' safety that the 1-exp correction provides at mu_s=1 is destroyed by the mu_s scaling. Both variants must be simulated separately and the per-term effect quantified in T11.01; T10 only implements the switch and does not draw the conclusion.
caveats: rho = 0.800 is a FITTED quantity that touches the parameterisation upper bound; it may only be reported as 'the highest reporting rate the data cannot exclude' (obligation O1).
mu_s = 12.3044 is a model-conditional quantity, NOT a biological lifespan estimate.
s(t) is an external supply/driver, not the in-model vector abundance V(t); V is a first-order lag filter of N_v with peak ratio ~0.899 (CL-16).
d = 2 weeks is a scalar observation-layer lag; the true reporting delay is long-tailed (CL-12/A14).
Single-season data only (obligation O9); chikungunya confounding not separated (obligation O8).
